31700-VII.s: This bill adopts the 2009 departmental budget (begrotingsstaat) of the Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations, setting appropriations for its policy articles and non-policy articles in thousands of euros. It also sets the 2009 operating budgets for the baten-lastendiensten KLPD, BPR, CAS, P-Direkt, LFR and the Werkmaatschappij.
q: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations (VII) for the year 2009, annexed to this law, is hereby established.
De bij deze wet behorende departementale begrotingsstaat van het ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties (VII) voor het jaar 2009 wordt vastgesteld.

31965-III.s: This bill amends the 2009 budget statements of the Ministry of General Affairs, the Royal Cabinet and the Commission for the oversight of intelligence and security services, adjusting spending in line with the spring memorandum. The changes take effect from 1 June 2009 and are backdated accordingly if the Staatsblad is published later.
q: The present bill aims to make changes for the year 2009 to the budget statements of the Ministry of General Affairs, the Royal Cabinet and the Commission for the oversight of intelligence and security services.

Het onderhavige wetsvoorstel strekt ertoe om voor het jaar 2009 wijzigingen aan te brengen in de begrotingsstaten van het Ministerie van Algemene Zaken, het Kabinet der Koningin en de Commissie van toezicht betreffende de inlichtingen- en veiligheidsdiensten.

32123-VII.s: This bill fixes the 2010 departmental budget of the Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations and the budgets of six baten-lastendiensten, expressed in thousands of euros. It is a budget appropriation law with no delegation of rule-making power to the executive.
q: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations (VII) for the year 2010 belonging to this law is hereby established.
De bij deze wet behorende departementale begrotingsstaat van het ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties (VII) voor het jaar 2010 wordt vastgesteld.

32222-VII.s: The bill amends the 2009 departmental budget statements of the Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations, including the supplementary budget (Najaarsnota) figures for expenditure and revenue across policy articles and agency operations. It sets the amended figures in thousands of euros and fixes the entry-into-force rules, with retroactive effect to 1 December 2009 where the Staatsblad is published later.
q: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations (VII) for the year 2009 is amended, as shown in the statement attached to this law.

De departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties (VII) voor het jaar 2009 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

32609-VI.s: The bill amends the 2011 departmental and agency budget statements of the Ministry of Security and Justice, mainly reallocating funds between articles and moving some tasks and costs (e.g., legal aid, supervision of professions, police, asylum-related apparatus costs). It implements Regeerakkoord budget cuts and reallocations without creating new executive rule-making powers.
32609-VI.j: The memorandum justifies the changes as budgetary adjustments following the coalition agreement, not as a grant of new executive powers.
q: To prevent access to justice for those with limited means from being endangered, accompanying measures are taken (€100 million) via legal aid.
Om te voorkomen dat de toegang tot het recht voor minderdraagkrachtigen in gevaar komt worden flankerende maatregelen getroffen (€ 100 mln.) via de rechtsbijstand.

32780-IV.s: This bill amends the 2011 budget statement of the Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations (Koninkrijksrelaties, part IV), increasing expenditure on the Recherche Samenwerkings Team (RST) by 1,000 thousand euros under the judiciary and cooperation article. It is a supplementary budget adjustment tied to the Voorjaarsnota, taking effect from 1 June 2011.
q: Amendment of the 2011 budget statement of Kingdom Relations (IV) (amendment linked to the Spring Memorandum)
Wijziging van de begrotingsstaat van Koninkrijksrelaties (IV) voor het jaar 2011 (wijziging samenhangend met de Voorjaarsnota)

32780-VI.s: This bill amends the 2011 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Security and Justice, adjusting appropriations and receipts across policy and non-policy articles following the spring memorandum. It sets the amended budget figures in thousands of euros and specifies entry into force from 1 June 2011.
q: We, with the joint consultation of the States General, have found and decided, as We find and decide hereby
Wij met gemeen overleg der Staten-Generaal, hebben goedgevonden en verstaan, gelijk Wij goedvinden en verstaan bij deze

33280-IXB.s: This bill amends the 2012 departmental budget (begrotingsstaat) of the Ministry of Finance (IXB) following the spring memorandum, adjusting appropriations and receipts across policy articles such as taxation, financial markets, and export credit insurance. It also exempts the Minister of Finance from submitting a provisional account (Voorlopige Rekening) to the States General for 2012.
33280-IXB.j: The memorandum does not explicitly justify the exemption from the provisional account; it explains the budget mutations as arising from ABP premium increases, extra fiscal implementation costs, shifting funds to later years and technical adjustments.
q: Notwithstanding Article 50 of the Comptabiliteitswet 2001, the Minister of Finance shall not submit a provisional account to the States General for 2012.
In afwijking van artikel 50 van de Comptabiliteitswet 2001 biedt Onze Minister van Financiën voor het jaar 2012 geen Voorlopige Rekening aan de Staten-Generaal aan.
p: The Minister of Finance is exempted from the statutory obligation to submit a provisional account to the States General for 2012, reducing parliamentary information on budget execution.

33605-IXA.s: This bill is a slotwet that amends the 2012 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Finance (IXA, Nationale Schuld) by adjusting the appropriations and receipts figures for debt financing and cash management. It sets the budget amounts in thousands of euros and makes the amendment effective from the day after publication, retroactive to 31 December of the budget year.
q: The departmental budget statement of National Debt (IXA) for the year 2012 is amended, as shown in the statement attached to this law.
De departementale begrotingsstaat van Nationale Schuld (IXA) voor het jaar 2012 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

33750-IX.s: The bill fixes the 2014 departmental budget statement for the Ministry of Finance (IXB), the National Debt budget statement (IXA) and the budget statement for the Domeinen Roerende Zaken agency. It also sets temporary departures from the Comptabiliteitswet 2001, including merging the Finance and National Debt statements into one law, dropping the Voorlopige Rekening, and allowing commitments-cash agencies with reserves.
33750-IX.j: The memorandum justifies the temporary deviations as administrative burden reduction and as following from the evaluation of the baten-lastendienst model, with the Algemene Rekenkamer able to keep reporting on irregularities.
q: The proposed integration meets this condition and does not change the tolerance limits used in the audit.
De voorgestelde integratie voldoet aan deze voorwaarde en leidt ook niet tot wijziging van de tolerantiegrenzen die bij de controle worden gehanteerd.
p: The Minister of Finance no longer submits a Voorlopige Rekening to the States General; post-Najaarsnota changes are instead reported through the Financieel Jaarverslag and slotwetten.
Ministers may set up commitments-cash agencies with management rules that depart from both regular and baten-lasten rules, and agencies may hold cash reserves outside the usual budget framework.

33899.s: The bill amends the Wegenverkeerswet 1994 so that the minister of Infrastructure and Environment adopts national designs for road directional signage (bewegwijzering) and maintains a register of such designs, with wegbeheerders obliged to follow them. It also sets cost recovery through a tariff and allows the minister alone to grant exemptions from the design requirement.
33899.j: The memorandum justifies central design authority by the need for coherence, uniformity and continuity of signage across individual road authorities' boundaries, and rejects enforceable CROW guidelines and interbestuurlijk toezicht as alternatives.
q: For this it is necessary that responsibility for that coherence, with appropriate powers, is assigned to a single organisation.
Hiervoor is het nodig dat de verantwoordelijkheid voor die samenhang, met daarbij passende bevoegdheden, bij één organisatie wordt belegd.
d: categories of traffic signs counted as directional signage
rules on register and data provision
rules for exemptions from the design requirement
p: The minister, after consultation with road authorities, adopts binding national designs for signage on the whole road network, displacing local road-authority discretion.
Only the minister may grant or refuse exemptions from the design requirement, concentrating that decision in the executive.

parties: Asks why an existing body (NDW) was not adapted instead of creating the NBd, how overlap is avoided, and whether central regulation could be combined with tendering.
The VVD members ask how it will be prevented that the NBd ends up overlapping in its work with the NDW.
De leden van deze fractie vragen hoe wordt voorkomen dat de NBd overlap van werkzaamheden gaat krijgen met de NDW.
Supports the bill and central ministerial regulation of signage; asks about data ownership, access and innovation role.
These members welcome that regulation is again organised from the ministry to guarantee coherence in national signage.
Deze leden zijn te spreken over het feit dat er weer regie wordt georganiseerd vanuit het ministerie om daarmee de samenhang in de nationale bewegwijzering te garanderen.
Asks whether the minister's system responsibility for signage is legally secured and warns against cross-subsidisation and non-market tariffs by the NBd.
According to these members, however, it is questionable whether the minister's system responsibility for signage is thereby fully secured in law.
Het is volgens de leden van deze fractie echter de vraag of daarmee sluitend de systeemverantwoordelijkheid van de Minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu voor bewegwijzering wettelijk wordt geborgd.
Has no questions and sees no reason for further questions.
The SP members have taken note of the amendment to the Road Traffic Act 1994 concerning signage designs and see no reason to ask further questions.

De leden van de SP-fractie hebben kennis genomen van de Wijziging van de Wegenverkeerswet 1994 in verband met de ontwerpen voor bewegwijzering en zien geen aanleiding tot het stellen van nadere vragen.

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division supported the bill on national road signage design (Wegenverkeerswet amendment) but raised objections on mixing statutory and non-statutory tasks within the Nationale Bewegwijzeringsdienst, cross-subsidisation and data access, the lack of a specific directive power in intergovernmental supervision, and the position of private road managers, advising adaptation. The minister's reply accepted the points on tendering, data pricing and separate accounting, rejected the need for a directive power by pointing to replacement supervision, and addressed private road managers through a ministerial exemption and appealability.
concerns: The Afdeling advised that a specific directive (aanwijzings) power in the bill is unnecessary because the generic replacement decision in the Provinciewet, Gemeentewet and Waterschapswet already achieves the same result, and the government adjusted the explanatory memorandum accordingly.

The Afdeling flagged that combining statutory and non-statutory tasks in one service risks cross-subsidisation and unfair competition, requiring cost allocation and separate accounting, which the government accepted and added to the explanatory memorandum.

The Afdeling noted that data supplied from the road-sign register to the NBd for non-statutory tasks must be on the same terms and tariffs as other users, and the government clarified this in the memorandum.

The Afdeling asked how private road managers such as Schiphol and farmers are protected in planning, and whether an adopted sign design is appealable, and the government answered via a ministerial exemption, explanatory additions and the view that the design is an appealable decision.

The Afdeling suggested drafting changes including alphabetising 26 definitions and restructuring article II, with the government adopting the drafting changes but not the alphabetisation because of cross-references.

33930-IX.s: This bill adopts the 2013 supplementary budget statements (slotwet) for the Ministry of Finance (IXB), the National Debt (IXA), and the Domeinen Roerende Zaken agency, recording realised figures against the adopted budget. It also exempts the 2013 Financieel jaarverslag van het Rijk from publishing the state balance sheet required by article 61(2)(d) of the Comptabiliteitswet 2001.
33930-IX.j: The memorandum justifies the article 5 derogation from the Comptabiliteitswet by the decision not to include the state balance sheet in the 2013 annual report, with a structural amendment to follow in a later Comptabiliteitswet revision.

33989.s: The bill amends Article 13 of the Constitution to extend the protection of letter, telephone and telegraph secrecy to all current and future communication means, under the umbrella of a single right to correspondence and telecommunication secrecy. It requires a prior judicial authorisation for restrictions, with an exception for national security restrictions authorised by persons designated by statute, and adds a temporary transitional provision.
33989.j: The memorandum justifies the national security exception by the earlier commission's and cabinet's view that a general exception is desirable where national security is at stake.
q: Restriction of this right is possible in the cases provided by law with the authorisation of a judge or, in the interest of national security, by or with authorisation of those designated by law for that purpose.

Beperking van dit recht is mogelijk in de gevallen bij de wet bepaald met machtiging van de rechter of, in het belang van de nationale veiligheid, door of met machtiging van hen die daartoe bij de wet zijn aangewezen.
d: restrictions in the interest of national security authorised by designated persons
p: Restrictions on communication secrecy for national security may be authorised by persons designated by law instead of a judge, reducing judicial protection in that category.

parties: Asks whether the national security exception means the executive may replace judicial authorisation, and what the legislature may choose.
May the legislature in future choose judicial review for certain national security situations and executive authorisation for others?
Mag de wetgever straks voor bepaalde situaties die de nationale veiligheid betreffen, kiezen voor een rechterlijke toetsing en in andere van dergelijke situaties kiezen voor de uitvoerende macht?
Objects that under the bill breaches of letter secrecy for national security no longer require judicial review, and asks whether technology neutrality justifies this.
Judicial review in the context of letter secrecy is therefore no longer required where national security is at stake.
De rechterlijke toets in is het kader van het briefgeheim in het geval dat de nationale veiligheid aan de orde is dus niet langer een vereiste.
Has reservations about lowering protection of letter secrecy for national security, notes the broad notion of national security, and asks why a higher standard is not applied to other communication.
The SP members have reservations about reducing the protection of letter secrecy where national security is concerned.
Reserves hebben de leden van de SP-fractie bij het verminderen van de bescherming van het briefgeheim wanneer het gaat om de nationale veiligheid.
Asks why prior judicial review is not mandatory regardless of national security interests, citing the Telegraaf case at the ECtHR.
There are therefore cases for which even the national security interest does not justify the absence of prior judicial review.
Er zijn dus gevallen waarvoor ook het belang van de nationale veiligheid geen afwezigheid van voorafgaande rechterlijke toetsing rechtvaardigt.
Critical of excluding judicial review for national security, asks for justification and argues an independent judge provides checks and balances.
From a rule-of-law perspective, the ChristenUnie members find that an independent judge can give content to the requirement of checks and balances.
De leden van de fractie van de ChristenUnie vinden vanuit rechtsstatelijk oogpunt dat juist een onafhankelijke rechter invulling kan geven aan het vereiste van checks and balances.
Asks for an overview of laws that must be amended and whether the state should protect privacy against private companies, including through horizontal effect.
The SP members ask the government to provide an overview of articles in laws that (may) need to be amended.
De leden van de SP-fractie vragen de regering een overzicht te geven van artikelen in wetten die (mogelijk) moeten worden aangepast.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on a draft constitutional amendment merging the letter and telephone/telegraph secrecy into a single brief- en telecommunicatiegeheim, urging retention of separate letter secrecy with its judicial-authorisation requirement, deletion of the new third paragraph on regulating private-sphere protection, and clarification of transitional law and ministerial mandate limits. The government's reply (nader rapport) accepted deleting the third paragraph and transitional clarifications but rejected preserving separate letter secrecy, arguing technology-neutrality requires equal protection.
concerns: Merging letter secrecy with telecommunications secrecy lowers protection of letters by allowing restriction in national security cases without judicial authorisation, which the Afdeling found insufficiently justified.
The new third paragraph creates unclear scope suggesting horizontal effect and an active state duty, which the Afdeling advised deleting; the government deleted it.
The third paragraph's regulatory mandate was found unnecessary given existing Postwet and Telecommunicatiewet protections, and the government accepted this.

Ministerial authorisation should be exercised personally without mandate, which the Afdeling asked to be addressed in the explanatory memorandum; the government explained mandate is set at statutory level.
Transitional provision was imprecise about whether existing restrictions lapse after four years and which statutes are covered, and the government amended it.
Traffic data protection and European Court of Human Rights case law on secret surveillance oversight should be addressed, which the government partly did in the explanatory memorandum.
Redactional remarks on the title and an incorrect statement about historical wording were adopted.

34085-IV.s: The bill amends the 2014 budget statement of the Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations through a second supplementary budget, adjusting appropriations in thousands of euros and setting entry into force from 1 December 2014. It contains no delegation of rule-making power and mainly reallocates funds between policy articles and reserves.
q: Amended as shown in the corresponding statement attached to this law.
Wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

34085-VI.s: This bill amends the 2014 budget (second supplementary budget) of the Ministry of Security and Justice, changing expenditure, revenue and commitment figures across policy articles and agencies. It sets the effective date of the amended budget statute as 1 December 2014 with retroactive effect where publication is later.
q: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Security and Justice for 2014 is amended as shown in the statement attached to this law.
Artikel 1 De departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Veiligheid en Justitie, voor het jaar 2014 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

34200-XII.s: This bill adopts the 2014 budget adjustment (Slotwet) for the Ministry of Infrastructure and the Environment and its agencies, changing the departmental budget statement and agency budget statements to reflect realised expenditure and revenue. It makes only technical, accounting and audit-driven budget changes, with effect from the day after publication and retroactive to 31 December of the budget year.
q: This bill contains only technical implementation changes, accounting-type changes, or changes arising from audit findings.
In dit wetsvoorstel zijn alleen technische uitvoeringsmutaties, mutaties van boekhoudkundige aard of mutaties voortvloeiend uit controlebevindingen opgenomen.

34485-III.s: The bill amends the 2016 budget statutes (first supplementary budget) for the Ministry of General Affairs, the Cabinet of the King, and the Committee for the Oversight of the Intelligence and Security Services, mainly by adding budget for wage and price adjustments and reallocations. It sets the amounts in thousands of euros and makes the changes effective from 1 June 2016.
q: The present bill aims to make changes for the year 2016 to the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of General Affairs (IIIA), the budget statement of the Cabinet of the King (IIIB), and the budget statement of the Committee for the Oversight of the Intelligence and Security Services (IIIC).

Het onderhavige wetsvoorstel strekt ertoe om voor het jaar 2016 wijzigingen aan te brengen in de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Algemene Zaken (IIIA), de begrotingsstaat van het Kabinet van de Koning (IIIB) en de begrotingsstaat van de Commissie van Toezicht betreffende de Inlichtingen- en Veiligheidsdiensten (IIIC).

34799.s: The bill moves the power to cap how much commercial radio frequency spectrum one party may hold, currently in Mediawet 2008 article 6.24 (FM), into Telecommunicatiewet article 3.11, allowing the minister to set such caps by ministerial regulation across frequency categories and to aggregate related parties. It also repeals article 6.24 of the Mediawet and makes consequential redactional amendments.
34799.j: The memorandum justifies the move as a codification of an existing power into an integral frequency policy, with the detailed rules delegated so they can follow market developments.
q: However, this is a discretionary power, meaning that article 3.11 of the Act merely creates a possibility to set a maximum amount of frequency space.
Het betreft hier echter een discretionaire bevoegdheid, hetgeen betekent dat artikel 3.11 van de wet slechts een mogelijkheid creëert om een maximale hoeveelheid frequentieruimte vast te stellen.
d: maximum frequency spectrum a person may use or acquire, by category and period
when natural or legal persons are treated as one for the spectrum cap
p: The minister gains discretionary power, via ministerial regulation, to set spectrum caps that were previously fixed in the Mediawet, and the provision now covers spectrum allocated by first-come-first-served as well as by auction, with the need for a cap decided case by case.

parties: Worries that leaving the group definition to a ministerial regulation creates a risk of arbitrariness and less legal certainty, and asks why caps are imposed without scarcity.

These members ask whether the government agrees that the ministerial regulation envisaged in article 3.11(2) Tw potentially creates a risk of arbitrariness and offers less objectivity, legal certainty and uniformity than the concept of 'group'.

Deze leden vragen of de regering de mening dat de in artikel 3.11, tweede lid, Tw beoogde ministeriële regeling potentieel een risico op willekeur oproept, en in elk geval minder objectiviteit, rechtszekerheid en uniformiteit biedt dan het begrip «groep».
Asks whether future amendments to the spectrum-use restriction by ministerial regulation will be subject to prior parliamentary consultation via a pre-consultation (voorhang) procedure.

Can the government commit that the House of Representatives will be consulted in advance if the government intends in future to amend the spectrum-use restriction via a ministerial regulation, so that the House is not faced with a fait accompli?

Kan de regering toezeggen dat de Tweede Kamer vooraf zal worden betrokken indien er in de toekomst een voornemen is van de regering om de gebruiksbeperking voor frequentieruimte via een ministeriele regeling aan te passen, zodat de Tweede Kamer niet voor een voldongen feit komt te staan?

34845-III.s: This second supplementary budget amendment for 2017 changes the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of General Affairs (IIIA) by reducing expenditure by 525 thousand euros and revenue by 500 thousand euros. It takes effect from 1 December 2017 and is a purely budgetary adjustment without new executive powers.
q: The adjustment concerns an expected shortfall of € 0.5 million in revenue.
De bijstelling betreft een verwachte tegenvaller van € 0,5 miljoen bij de ontvangsten.

34889.s: The bill implements EU Directive 2016/680 on processing of personal data by competent authorities for criminal law enforcement by amending the Police Data Act (Wet politiegegevens) and the Judicial and Criminal Procedure Data Act, adding obligations on security, impact assessments, breach notification, data subject rights, logging, and oversight by the Data Protection Authority. It also expands the Authority's independence, investigative powers and fine powers.
34889.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations and restrictions as necessary for faithful implementation of the directive and for practical operation of police and justice data processing, while noting that the rules on exceptions and access must be balanced against citizens' rights.
d: security measures for personal data processing
rules on transfers of police data within the EU
rules on transfers of police data to third countries and international organisations
p: The controller may postpone the decision on a data access request by four weeks, or six weeks where several units process data on the requester.
Access and rectification requests may be refused on broad grounds including national security, and categories of data may be excluded from access entirely.
Former provisions on court remedies are removed and replaced with a complaint route to the Data Protection Authority and a court action against that authority.
The Data Protection Authority is given a fully independent position with investigative, corrective and administrative fine powers over police and justice data processing.

parties: Asks whether the restriction of data subjects' information and access rights (informants, infiltrants, witness protection) is broad enough and whether data-sharing for crime fighting is made too difficult by strict rules.
Can the government explain why this will not lead to a lot of extra administration?
Kan de regering aangeven waarom dit niet tot veel extra administratie zal leiden?

Asks whether the police and the Public Prosecution Service should be consulted on the bill, and raises the Data Protection Authority's objections on the applicable regimes for border control and migration data.
Given that this bill affects the work of the police and the Public Prosecution Service, these members consider it important that these organisations are asked for advice on this subject.

Gezien het feit dat onderhavig wetsvoorstel van invloed is op het werk van politie en het OM, achten deze leden het van belang dat deze organisaties om advies gevraagd wordt betreffende dit onderwerp.

Raises risks of big-data profiling and of evidence obtained through special investigative powers spreading to other criminal files before unlawfulness rulings become final, since the Judicial Data Act lacks an independent lawfulness criterion.

The members would like a further explanation of whether and how the government has taken into account these developments in large-scale data processing and the associated risks to privacy of data subjects in this bill implementing the Directive.

Graag vernemen de aan het woord zijnde leden een nadere toelichting of, en zo ja hoe, de regering in dit voorstel tot uitvoering van de Richtlijn rekening heeft gehouden met deze ontwikkelingen van grootschalige gegevensverwerkingen en de daarbij behorende voornoemde risico's voor inbreuken op de persoonlijke levenssfeer van betrokkenen.

Asks about the Data Protection Authority's additional tasks and its criticism that minimum implementation hampers compliance, and whether the government will respond point by point to the Authority's advice.
The members ask whether the government can respond point by point to each of the points from the Data Protection Authority's advisory letter on this bill.
De voornoemde leden vragen of de regering puntsgewijs kan reageren op elk van de punten van de AP uit haar adviesbrief ten aanzien van dit wetsvoorstel.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on the bill implementing the EU police and justice data protection directive into the Wpg and Wjsg, criticising summary impact assessment, complex vague norms, ICT problems, technological developments, scope of the police assistance task, fines, and special-category data safeguards. The government's reply (nader rapport) states that almost all points were followed by amending the bill and explanatory memorandum.
concerns: The Afdeling finds the impact on implementation summarily treated and asks for more attention to practical application, vague norms, ICT and training; the government added a fuller discussion in the explanatory memorandum.

Technological developments such as big data analysis may undermine the basic principles of data protection, and the Afdeling asks how the regulation is tailored to them; the government added discussion in the memorandum.

Special-category data may be processed without the appropriate safeguards required by the directive being written into the bill, and automated individual decision-making lacks the required additional measures; the bill was amended accordingly.
Differing time limits and categories of persons across the Wpg and Wjsg lack justification and uniformity; the government aligned the categories and explained the time limits.
The Wjsg does not oblige authorities to give reasons for refusing access, rectification or erasure requests; the bill was amended to require this.
The discrepancy between the administrative fines under the GDPR and those proposed for police and justice is inadequately explained; the government explained it and revised the fines regime.
Including police assistance tasks in the scope of the Wpg rather than the directive is insufficiently motivated; the government gave a fuller justification in the memorandum.
No evaluation clause was included; the government added a three-year evaluation provision.
Numerous redactional and terminological corrections were proposed and largely incorporated.

34979.s: The bill amends the Dutch Aviation Act to implement EU Regulation 376/2014 on occurrence reporting in civil aviation, replacing national reporting duties with references to the EU regulation. It lets the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management set by ministerial regulation the systems for mandatory and voluntary reporting, extends the regulation to certain special aircraft by general administrative order, designates the House for Whistleblowers for certain tasks, and adds administrative fines for failure to report.
34979.j: The memorandum justifies the new ministerial and general administrative order powers by the need for national rules where the EU regulation requires implementation and to allow quick, adequate enforcement.
q: The bill thus provides a basis for establishing a ministerial regulation on setting up systems for mandatory and voluntary reporting of occurrences.
Zo biedt het wetsvoorstel een grondslag voor het vaststellen van een ministeriële regeling voor het inrichten van systemen voor het verplicht en vrijwillig melden van voorvallen.
d: systems for mandatory and voluntary occurrence reporting and independent analysis mechanism
collection and processing of safety information beyond reporting systems
application of the EU regulation to special aircraft such as historic, experimental and amateur-built aircraft
p: The Minister gains power to impose administrative enforcement and fines of up to 1,000 euro on individuals and 2,000 euro on organisations for failure to report occurrences.
The State is barred from prosecuting unintentional violations known only through mandatory or voluntary reports, protecting reporters against use of their information.

parties: The VVD has no questions or comments on the bill.
but have no further questions or comments on this.
maar hebben hierover verder geen vragen of opmerkingen.
The CDA doubts the government has adequately answered the Raad van State's objection that designating the Huis voor klokkenluiders as the body for culture and fairness may not meet the regulation.
According to these members it is very much in question to what extent the government's reference actually meets the provision in the regulation.](#)
Het is volgens deze leden zeer de vraag in hoeverre met de door de regering gedane verwijzing daadwerkelijk wordt voldaan aan de bepaling in de verordening.
GroenLinks supports EU rules making reporting mandatory and protecting reporters, and wants the Raad van State's advice on whistleblower protection adopted.
Especially the protection of whistleblowers must, as far as the GroenLinks members are concerned, be properly arranged.
Met name de bescherming van klokkenluiders moet wat de leden van de GroenLinks-fractie betreft goed worden geregeld.
The party asks why the government did not follow the Raad van State's advice on the Huis voor klokkenluiders and doubts adequate safeguards for whistleblowers and the OVV's safety concerns.
Can the government explain its choice not to follow the Raad van State's advice to designate a Huis voor klokkenluiders as a body for 'culture and fairness'?
Kan de regering een toelichting geven op de keuze om geen gevolg te geven aan het advies van de Raad van State om een Huis voor klokkenluiders als orgaan voor «cultuur en billijkheid» aan te wijzen?

v.summary: The Raad van State's Afdeling advisering advises sending the bill implementing EU Regulation 376/2014 on occurrence reporting in civil aviation to parliament, but asks for supplementation regarding the Huis voor klokkenluiders acting as the 'culture of fairness' body and for better justification of halving the maximum fine for non-reporting. The minister's nader rapport reports that the bill was amended: the Huis is designated as the body with explicit tasks, and the individual fine maximum was restored to 1,000 euro, with 2,000 euro for organisations.
concerns: The Afdeling asked that the Huis voor klokkenluiders be explicitly designated as the body under Article 16(12) of the regulation with its new tasks spelled out, and the bill was amended accordingly for the relevant tasks.

The Afdeling noted gaps in supervision of prohibited legal proceedings against reporters and of organisations' internal rules; the government addressed these via an existing article 11.25 Wet luchtvaart route and works council consent powers in the explanatory memorandum rather than new Huis powers.

The Afdeling found the halving of the fine maximum for individuals insufficiently motivated, since fine levels should not depend on compliance rates, and the government restored the 1,000 euro maximum.

The Afdeling's redactional comments on designating the competent authority, adjusting the transposition table, extending Article 11.1 and deleting the redundant Article II were noted as taken into account.

34988.s: This bill amends the 2018 budget statement of Kingdom Relations (third supplementary budget), adjusting appropriations and expenditure figures for several articles including Caribbean emergency relief and reconstruction. It is a budgetary act with effect from 9 July 2018 and does not delegate rule-making powers.
q: Amendment of the budget statement of Kingdom Relations (IV) for the year 2018.
Wijziging van de begrotingsstaat van Koninkrijksrelaties (IV), alle voor het jaar 2018.

35210-VII.s: This first supplementary budget bill amends the 2019 departmental budget of the Ministry of Interior and Kingdom Relations and the budget for its agencies, expressed in thousands of euros. It sets the entry into force as 1 June 2019 with retroactive effect where the Staatsblad is published later.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Interior and Kingdom Relations
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat

35300-VII.s: This is the Dutch 2020 budget bill (Voorstel van wet, Vergaderjaar 2019-2020) that establishes the departmental expenditure and revenue budget for the Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations (BZK) and the budgets for its executive agencies for 2020. The explanatory memorandum extract discusses electoral reform, local government oversight, digital government and budgetary matters, but the bill itself delegates no rule-making power.
q: The departmental budget statement attached to this law for the year 2020 is hereby established.
De bij deze wet behorende departementale begrotingsstaat voor het jaar 2020 wordt vastgesteld.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised that it has no remarks on the 2020 budget bills (blanco adviezen) for the ministries and funds listed, and recommends submitting them to the Tweede Kamer. The Minister of Finance's nader rapport states that some budgets require amendments, referred to in annexes, and forwards the opinions for public disclosure.

35570-IV.s: The bill fixes the 2021 budget statements for Koninkrijksrelaties (Kingdom Relations) and the BES-fonds for the Caribbean Netherlands in a single law. The explanatory memorandum describes financial supervision of Curaçao, Sint Maarten, Aruba and the BES islands, and the planned expansion of the overview of national spending on the Caribbean Netherlands.
35570-IV.j: The memorandum justifies the budget law by the constitutional requirement under article 105 of the Constitution and the Comptabiliteitswet 2016 that the budget be set by law, aiming at better insight into effectiveness and efficiency.
q: The budget statements forming part of the national budget are each set separately by law under article 2.3, first paragraph, of the Comptabiliteitswet 2016.
De begrotingsstaten die onderdeel zijn van de Rijksbegroting, worden op grond van artikel 2.3, eerste lid, van de Comptabiliteitswet 2016 elk afzonderlijk bij de wet vastgesteld.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on the 2021 budget bills (begrotingsstaten) for several ministries and funds and found no remarks, so it advised submitting them to parliament. The government's nader rapport confirms this, notes one non-blank advice on the Ministry of Finance budget addressed in an annex, and announces some budget amendments.

35570-VI.s: This bill fixes the 2021 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Justice and Security and the 2021 budget statements of its executive agencies (DJI, CJIB, NFI, IND, Justis) in thousands of euros, with effect from 1 January 2021. It also states that the Minister for Legal Protection is not responsible for the efficiency of the judiciary's operations, which the Raad voor de rechtspraak manages under integral management.
35570-VI.j: The memorandum justifies the non-responsibility provision by the new division of competences under which the judiciary manages its own operations, while the Minister keeps a supervisory role and may issue general directions under article 93 of the Wet op de rechterlijke organisatie.
q: Referring to article 4.1 of the Comptabiliteitswet 2016 in conjunction with articles 23 and 91 of the Wet op de rechterlijke organisatie, the Minister for Legal Protection is not responsible for the efficiency of the judiciary's business operations.

Onder verwijzing naar artikel 4.1 van de Comptabiliteitswet 2016 jo. de artikelen 23 en 91 van de Wet op de rechterlijke organisatie is Onze Minister voor Rechtsbescherming niet verantwoordelijk voor de doelmatigheid van de bedrijfsvoering van de rechterlijke organisatie.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division had no remarks on the 2021 budget bill for the Ministry of Justice and Security and advised submitting it to the Tweede Kamer. The Minister of Finance's nader rapport confirms the advice is taken without remarks and notes changes to several budgets, with one non-blank advice concerning the Ministry of Finance budget.

35789.s: The bill amends Article 137 of the Constitution so that the second reading of a proposed constitutional amendment is held by the next elected Tweede Kamer, with the Eerste Kamer following, and adds a transitional article governing which procedure applies to amendments already in progress. It also provides that the transitional article itself lapses at a time set by statute once the affected amendment procedures are complete.
35789.j: The memorandum justifies the bill only by reference to the first-reading debates and the constitutional requirement of a second reading after dissolution, giving no separate rationale for delegation.
q: The Constitution requires that after the publication of such a declaratory act and dissolution of the Tweede Kamer, a second reading of the constitutional proposal takes place.
De Grondwet schrijft voor dat na de bekendmaking van een dergelijke verklaringswet – en ontbinding van de Tweede Kamer – een tweede lezing van het grondwetsvoorstel plaatsvindt.
d: time of expiry of transitional article

parties: Welcomes the clarification of the constitutional amendment procedure and has no questions for the government.
The bill gives the VVD members no reason to put questions to the government.
Het wetsvoorstel geeft de leden van de VVD-fractie geen aanleiding tot het stellen van vragen aan de regering.
Asks whether the Voorzitter-based Reglement van Orde route and the constitutional lapse rule are aligned and whether timely second-reading treatment is guaranteed.
Can the government therefore state with certainty that timely, thorough treatment in second reading will always be possible?
Durft de regering hierdoor met zekerheid te stellen dat een tijdige, gedegen wetsbehandeling in tweede lezing altijd mogelijk zal zijn?
Supports clarifying the procedure but asks whether responsibilities under the amended Reglement van Orde are clearly regulated.
These members therefore endorse the government's aim to clarify the existing constitutional amendment procedure.
Deze leden onderschrijven dan ook het streven van de regering om de bestaande Grondwetsherzieningsprocedure te verduidelijken.
Has not changed its view on the first reading and sees no reason for further comments.
They see no reason to make further comments.
Zij zien geen aanlei-ding voor het maken van verdere opmerkingen.

Asks about the mandatory advice of the Raad van State on second-reading amendments, especially for initiative bills, and about the risk of politicisation if advice is dropped; also questions the wording on the Tweede Kamer deciding.
These members ask for a response to the risk that dropping mandatory advice could lead to it becoming too much of a political consideration.
Deze leden vragen een reactie op het risico dat het wegvallen van de verplichte advisering kan leiden tot het risico dat het teveel een politieke afweging kan worden.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State has no remarks on the draft bill amending the Constitution's provision on constitutional amendments (re-examination of the constitutional revision procedure) and advises submitting it to the Tweede Kamer. The government's reply, given in the Minister of Interior's letter, simply acknowledges that the proposal gives the Afdeling no reason for remarks and requests transmission to parliament.

35798.s: This bill amends the 2021 departmental budget of the Ministry of Social Affairs and Employment (second incidental supplementary budget), adjusting commitments, expenditure and receipts across policy and non-policy articles. It also sets the law's entry into force as 8 April 2021, with retroactive effect where the Staatsblad appears later.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the departmental budget of the Ministry of Social Affairs and Employment
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat

35888.s: The bill amends the Dutch implementing acts for international child protection and child abduction and the Civil Code and Code of Civil Procedure to implement the recast EU Regulation 2019/1111 (Brussels II-ter), abolishing exequatur and setting new procedures for recognition, enforcement, certificates and appeals in family and child custody cases. It also updates cross-references and adds enforcement rules for maintenance decisions.
35888.j: The memorandum justifies the changes as necessary to implement the EU regulation and to speed up and simplify cross-border recognition and enforcement of judgments in child custody and marriage matters.
q: To this end, the leave for enforcement of a decision from another Member State (the 'exequatur') is abolished.
Daartoe wordt het verlof tot tenuitvoerlegging van een beslissing uit een andere lidstaat (het «exequatur») afgeschaft
p: Artikel I, E (artikelen 18-23 Uitvoeringswet internationale kinderbescherming)

New enforcement procedures give the district court judge discretion to shorten enforcement waiting periods and to determine how enforcement is carried out, with appeal to the court of appeal and Supreme Court available.

parties: Welcomes the bill's aim to combat international child abduction and has no questions.
The aforementioned members are pleased that this gives substance to jointly combating international child abduction and the swiftest possible return of children.
Voornoemde leden zijn verheugd dat er op deze wijze invulling wordt gegeven aan het gezamenlijk bestrijden van internationale kinderontvoering en het zo snel mogelijk terugkeren van kinderen.
Asks whether mediation, child hearings and a special curator should apply in all parental responsibility procedures, and why the Dutch court-competence rule for urgent measures is not amended.
Can the government explain why this provision is not being amended, also in line with the comments of the Council for the Judiciary?
Kan de regering aangeven waarom deze bepaling niet wordt gewijzigd, ook in lijn met de opmerkingen van de Raad voor de rechtspraak?
Asks about average decision times for child return, consequences of missing the six-week limit, and the legal certainty effects of abolishing the enforcement leave requirement.
They ask for clarification on how work will be carried out now that an enforcement leave is no longer required.
Zij vragen verduidelijking over de wijze waarop er gewerkt gaat worden, nu er geen verlof tot tenuitvoerlegging meer nodig is.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on a bill amending the Uitvoeringswet internationale kinderbescherming to implement the recast of EU Regulation 2019/1111 on parental responsibility and international child abduction, and found no remarks on the proposal. The minister's nader rapport reports only some minor legislative-technical and editorial changes to the bill and explanatory memorandum, with no substantive changes.

35897.s: The bill is an omnibus amendment (Verzamelwet SZW 2022) that changes many social security and labour laws under the Ministry of Social Affairs, including repealing the AOW nationality requirement, extending deadlines and adding a hardship clause in the Inburgering and benefit laws, and repealing the Wet arbeid en zorg levensloop chapter. Several provisions alter the sanction and data-sharing regime, and the explanatory memorandum notes that a hardship clause was promised to parliament.
35897.j: The memorandum justifies the repeal of the AOW delegation by saying it has become redundant because the nationality requirement is being removed, and justifies the hardship clause by citing a parliamentary motion and a commitment made to parliament.
q: Where necessary, the SVB can further deviate from its policy and provide tailored service.
Waar nodig kan de SVB verder van haar beleid afwijken en maatwerk leveren.
d: conditions equating residence abroad with residence in the Netherlands for AOW
ARTIKEL IX C (Wet arbeidsongeschiktheidsvoorziening jonggehandicapten, artikel 2:32 lid 5)
temporary exemption from work-related conditions for young disabled persons
p: ARTIKEL IX B and C (WAJONG, artikelen 2:31, 2:32, 2:39)
Benefit conditions are reshaped so that failure to meet certain obligations no longer automatically ends income support, giving UWV more discretion over sanctions and enforcement.
ARTIKEL XIII (Wet inburgering, artikelen 29 and 32) and ARTIKEL XIV D (hardheidsclausule artikel 26a)
The minister may extend integration deadlines and the college and minister may set aside sanction provisions in cases of undue hardship, widening citizen protection against sanctions.
ARTIKEL XIV E (Wet inburgering 2021, artikel 34 lid 6)
The reception agency must provide the minister with data on the residence location of integration obligees, including where they will be housed, without a specified safeguard.
ARTIKEL XVII and XXI, ARTIKEL XXII (Wet op de arbeidsongeschiktheidsverzekering, WIA, Ziektewet, medical data)
Access to medical data and insurer statistics is restricted to the employee and authorised parties, removing an earlier consent-based pathway but limiting third-party access to sensitive information.

parties: Asks the government to explain the legal basis and implications of SVB not being bound to revise past decisions following court rulings, and the financial impact of the transitional date.
The VVD members read that according to case law on revising legally final decisions, the SVB is in principle not obliged to revise a decision, and therefore also the benefit concerned, for the past.

De leden van de VVD-fractie lezen dat uit de rechtspraak over de herziening van rechtens onaantastbare besluiten volgt dat de Sociale Verzekeringsbank (SVB) in beginsel niet gehouden is om een besluit, dus ook de uitkering waarop dat besluit betrekking heeft, voor het verleden te herzien.
Objects that non-policy-neutral proposals, such as the hardship clause, were placed in an omnibus bill bypassing separate parliamentary treatment, and demands a commitment to prevent this.
The SP members consider it a bad thing that proposals that are not policy-neutral end up in an omnibus bill.
De leden van de SP-fractie vinden het een slechte zaak dat voorstellen in een verzamelwet belanden die niet beleidsarm zijn.

Questions whether the general hardship provisions of the Awb suffice to prevent harsh outcomes for vulnerable inburgering participants when the hardship clause is removed, and asks about the sanctioning and data-sharing safeguards.
The D66 members ask whether the government can elaborate on the removal of the hardship clause for the inburgering law from the bill.
De leden van de D66-fractie vragen of de regering nader in kan gaan op het schrappen van de hardheidsclausule voor de inburgeringswet uit het wetsvoorstel.

Asks about the legal basis for data sharing with the employment agency and whether the child-benefit exception to the coupling principle implies that rights of children are harmed, asking for the government's view on the reservation to article 26 CRC.
Can the government explain in more detail what the precise legal obstacles are, and why it was not chosen to include a legal basis for this in the law instead of deleting the relevant articles?

Kan de regering nader toelichten wat precies de juridische belemmeringen hiervoor zijn, en waarom er niet voor is gekozen om een juridische grondslag hiervoor in de wet op te nemen, in plaats van het schrappen van de betreffende artikelen?
Asks for justification for dropping the distinction between active and passive voting rights in the works council provisions and for reasons for involving flexible workers in works councils.

The SGP members would like further justification for the choice to drop the distinction between active and passive voting rights in months (6 and 12 months respectively) with this shortening to three months.

De leden van de SGP-fractie zien graag een nadere onderbouwing van de keuze om het onderscheid tussen actief en passief kiesrecht qua aantal maanden (6 resp. 12 maanden) los te laten bij deze verkorting naar drie maanden.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised against including a hardship clause in the Wet inburgering 2021 within the omnibus bill (Verzamelwet SZW 2022), because existing safeguards already ensure proportionality of fines and such a substantive change needs separate parliamentary treatment. The Minister's reply accepted the advice, removed the hardship clause from the bill and said it would be handled in a separate proposal.
concerns: Existing legal safeguards (artikel 5:46 Awb and the variable fine regime) already ensure proportionate fines, so the added value of a hardship clause needed justification.
A substantive change to the integration regime like a hardship clause should not be slipped into an omnibus bill that is supposed to contain only technical changes.
Articles in the bill were not in alphabetical order, which was corrected in the amended bill and explanatory memorandum.

35925-III.s: The bill sets the 2022 departmental budget for the Ministry of General Affairs, the budget of its agency Dienst Publiek en Communicatie, and the budgets of the Kabinet van de Koning and the Commissie van Toezicht op de Inlichtingen- en Veiligheidsdiensten, all in thousands of euros. It also sets the entry into force date of 1 January 2022 with retroactive effect where publication is later.
q: The departmental budget statement for the year 2022 attached to this law is hereby established.
De bij deze wet behorende departementale begrotingsstaat voor het jaar 2022 wordt vastgesteld.

v.summary: The Raad van State Afdeling advisering issued a blanket advisory opinion on the 2022 budget bill for the Ministry of General Affairs, the Royal Household and the Supervisory Committee on the Intelligence and Security Services, raising no remarks and advising submission to the Tweede Kamer. The Minister of Finance's nader rapport accompanies the opinion and notes that some budgets require amendments, which are set out in annexes.

35975-V.s: The bill amends the 2021 departmental budget of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs (second supplementary budget), adjusting commitments, expenditure and receipts by policy and non-policy article. It takes effect the day after publication and is retroactive to 1 December 2021.
35975-V.j: The memorandum justifies the budget changes by Dutch EU payment obligations arising from a European Commission audit of traditional own resources accounting, rather than by any new executive power.
q: Following a recent audit of the TEM (traditional own resources) accounting at Customs, the European Commission requested a repayment totalling EUR 123.6 million.
Naar aanleiding van een recente controle van de TEM-boekhouding (Traditioneel Eigen Middelen) bij de Douane heeft de Europese Commissie verzocht om een nabetaling van in totaal EUR 123,6 miljoen.

35996.s: The bill amends the 2021 departmental budget of the Defence Materiel Budget Fund by raising commitment authority by 210,000 thousand euro, mainly for infrastructure and IT. It sets the budget in thousands of euro and takes effect on 21 December 2021, with retroactive effect if published later.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the departmental budget statement of the Defence Materiel Budget Fund (K) for the year 2021
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Defensiematerieelbegrotingsfonds (K) voor het jaar 2021

36200-VII.s: This bill (Begrotingswet 2023, Ministry of Interior and Kingdom Relations) sets the departmental budget statement (Art. 1) and the agency budget statement for 2023 (Art. 2), with amounts in thousands of euros and entry into force on 1 January 2023. It is a budget appropriation law with no delegation of rule-making power to the executive.
q: Article 1 The departmental budget statement belonging to this law for the year 2023 is established.
Artikel 1 De bij deze wet behorende departementale begrotingsstaat voor het jaar 2023 wordt vastgesteld.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on the 2023 budget bill for the Ministry of Interior and Kingdom Relations (VII) and raised no remarks, recommending submission to the Tweede Kamer. The Minister of Finance's nader rapport notes that some budgets require amendments and refers to attached annexes.

36360-IX.s: The bill amends the 2022 budget statements (Slotwet) for the Ministry of Finance (IXB) and the National Debt (IXA), adjusting appropriations, receipts and expenditures to realised figures. It sets the amounts in thousands of euros and takes effect the day after publication in the Staatsblad, retroactive to 31 December of the budget year.
q: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Finance (IXB) for the year 2022 is amended, as shown in the statement attached to this law.
Artikel 1 De departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Financiën (IXB) voor het jaar 2022 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

36470-IV.s: This bill amends the 2023 budget statements for Kingdom Relations (IV) and the BES Fund (H) through a second supplementary budget, adjusting expenditure and commitment figures in thousands of euros with effect from 1 December 2023. The explanatory memorandum shows mainly reallocations within article 1 (strengthening the rule of law), such as moving subsidies to contributions to subnational governments for the Caribbean Netherlands.
36470-IV.j: The memorandum justifies the changes as reallocations needed to book expenditure under the correct budget instrument, not as a grant of new powers.
q: This mainly concerns a reallocation for law enforcement for the Countries from the Subsidies instrument to the Contribution to subnational governments instrument, to account for the expenditure under the correct instrument.

Subsidies (regelingen) Bestuurlijke aanpak Dit betreft met name een reallocatie voor de rechtshandhaving voor de Landen van het instrument Subsidies naar het instrument Bijdrage medeoverheden , om de uitgaven op het juiste instrument te verantwoorden.

36470-VI.s: This bill amends the 2023 departmental budget of the Ministry of Justice and Security and the 2023 budget of its agencies (second supplementary budget), with effect from 1 December 2023. It changes appropriations and revenue lines across policy articles and agencies such as DJI, IND and CJIB, and contains no new delegation of rule-making power.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Justice and Security
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Justitie en Veiligheid

36560-IV.s: This slotwet amends the 2023 budget statements for Koninkrijksrelaties (IV) and the BES-fonds (H), recording the final budget figures after supplementary budgets. It sets the figures in thousands of euros and takes effect the day after publication, retroactive to 31 December of the budget year.
q: The budget statements are set in thousands of euros.
De vaststelling van de begrotingsstaten geschiedt in duizenden euro's.

36560-VI.s: This bill amends the 2023 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Justice and Security and the 2023 budget statement for its agencies, recording the adjusted budgets and realised figures in thousands of euros. It sets the effective date as the day after publication in the Staatsblad, applying retroactively to 31 December of the budget year.
q: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Justice and Security (VI) for the year 2023 is amended, as shown in the statement attached to this law.
De departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Justitie en Veiligheid (VI) voor het jaar 2023 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

36689.s: The bill approves, for the European part of the Netherlands, the Partnership and Cooperation Agreement between the EU and its member states and Singapore, concluded in Brussels on 19 October 2018, as required under Article 91(1) of the Constitution. It enters into force the day after publication in the Staatsblad.
q: In the government's view, the treaty contains no provisions binding on everyone within the meaning of Articles 93 and 94 of the Constitution that directly confer rights or impose obligations on legal subjects.

Naar het oordeel van de regering bevat het verdrag geen een ieder verbindende bepalingen in de zin van de artikelen 93 en 94 van de Grondwet, die aan rechtssubjecten rechtstreeks rechten toekennen of plichten opleggen.

parties: Asks how the government will pursue cooperation between the EU and individual ASEAN countries on critical raw materials, which the bills do not address.
The members of the VVD group note that the bills pay no attention to cooperation with individual ASEAN countries on critical raw materials.
De leden van de VVD-fractie constateren dat er in de wetsvoorstellen geen aandacht wordt besteed aan samenwerking met individuele ASEAN-landen op het gebied van kritieke grondstoffen.
Strongly supports closer ties with Singapore but raises concerns about limited freedom of expression and asks how the government promotes it and supports independent journalists.
The members of the D66 group note that there are many concerns about limited freedom of expression in Singapore.
De leden van de D66-fractie constateren dat er veel zorgen zijn over de beperkte vrijheid van meningsuiting in Singapore.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on a bill approving the EU-Singapore Partnership and Cooperation Agreement and found no remarks, advising submission to the Tweede Kamer. The minister's reply is a formal transmittal covering the advice, with no substantive points to respond to.

36740-IV.s: This bill (slotwet) amends the 2024 budget statements for Koninkrijksrelaties (IV) and the BES-fonds (H) to reflect supplementary budgets and realised spending. It contains no delegation of rule-making power and no explanatory memorandum was found.
q: We ... have found it necessary to amend the budget statement of Koninkrijksrelaties (IV) and the budget statement of the BES-fonds (H), both for the year 2024

Wij Willem-Alexander ... hebben goedgevonden en verstaan ... de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de begrotingsstaat van Koninkrijksrelaties (IV) en van de begrotingsstaat van het BES-fonds (H), alle voor het jaar 2024

36740-VI.s: This bill amends the 2024 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Justice and Security and the budget statement for its agencies, implementing the final budget adjustment (Slotwet) for 2024. It sets the amounts in thousands of euros and provides that the law takes effect the day after publication and applies retroactively to 31 December of the budget year.

36779.s: The bill amends the General Act on Income-Dependent Schemes (Awir) and related laws to improve childcare and other allowances: it removes interest charges on allowance repayments and payouts, abolishes the Tax and Customs Administration's power to impose negligence fines on citizens and to publish fines, adds exceptions to the allowance-partner rule for missing persons, detainees and refugees with partners abroad, and lets a general administrative order (AMvB) designate decision types whose retroactive effect is disregarded. It takes effect 1 January 2026, and the Minister must report to parliament within five years.
36779.j: The memorandum justifies the delegation as more flexible and faster than listing groups in the statute, and notes that the first cases are intended to take effect together with the bill.
q: This moreover offers more flexibility and speed than including the groups to which this principle applies in the statute itself.
Dit biedt bovendien meer flexibiliteit en snelheid dan het in de wet opnemen van de groepen waarvoor dit principe geldt.
d: designating decision types whose retroactive effect is disregarded for allowances
p: Allows an administrative order to set aside the statutory coupling principle for certain retroactive decisions, expanding executive discretion over benefit entitlements.
Removes the Tax and Customs Administration's power to impose negligence fines on citizens, reducing sanction power over citizens.

parties: Asks about the number of partners living abroad without a flight situation and the budgetary effects of treating them as single.
Would it be simpler to also place this group among single persons?
Zou het eenvoudiger zijn om deze groep ook onder de alleenstaanden te scharen?
Asks how misuse is prevented, whether the delegated power to exclude retroactive decisions is limited, and how the Chamber is involved in designating new decisions.
Which types of decisions will initially be designated by general administrative order and why was delegation chosen instead of an exhaustive list in the law itself?
Welke typen beschikkingen zullen in eerste instantie via algemene maatregel van bestuur worden aangewezen en waarom is gekozen voor delegatie in plaats van een limitatieve opsomming in de wet zelf?

Asks whether the delegation to exclude retroactive decisions by general administrative order can be bounded more tightly and whether the Chamber can be involved beforehand via a prior-consultation procedure.
Is the government willing to delimit this power more tightly in the law and involve the Chamber beforehand through a prior-consultation procedure?
Is de regering bereid om deze bevoegdheid strakker in de wet af te bakenen en daarbij de Kamer via een voorhangprocedure vooraf te betrekken?
Welcomes the partner exception and the public disclosure of penalties, asking about feasibility and whether other groups should be covered.
This concerns a long-cherished wish of these members for which they have often argued.
Dit betreft een lang gekoesterde wens van deze leden waarvoor ze vaak hebben gepleit.
Asks whether removing interest and the late-payment penalty removes an incentive to supply correct data and how misuse is prevented.
Does removing interest and the late-payment penalty not remove an incentive to supply correct data in time?
Vervalt met het schrappen van rente en de verzuimboete niet een prikkel om tijdig juiste gegevens aan te leveren?

v.summary: The Council of State advisory division advised on the Wet verbetermaatregelen toeslagen, questioning the removal of the power to impose late-filing fines on benefit recipients, the removal of publication of penalty fines for childcare benefit advisers, the open-ended delegation with a discretionary element for retroactive decisions, and the detailed partner exceptions, and recommended not submitting the bill unless amended. The government's nader rapport largely rejected the objections, kept the fine removal and partner exceptions, narrowed the delegation and removed the discretionary clause, and added explanatory text.
concerns: Removing the power to impose late-filing fines on benefit recipients weakens incentives and is not aligned with the proportionate enforcement approach used in social security; the government rejected this and retained the removal.
Removing the fine power may increase high recoveries; the government added explanation but did not reinstate the fine power.
The delegation for excluding retroactive decisions was too open-ended; the government narrowed it to decisions removing eligibility conditions.
The discretionary kan-provision in the delegation was unnecessary and was removed.
Removing the power to publicise penalty fines against childcare benefit advisers lacked adequate justification; the government argued publication fits tax matters better and retained the removal.

The narrow partner exceptions are detailed legislation for a small group and may need broader generic rules; the government kept the specific exceptions while acknowledging generic solutions require more time.

36797.s: The bill modernises the Luchtvaartwet BES to implement ICAO standards on air navigation services, adding definitions, a certification regime for air navigation service providers, and new grounds for ministerial designation, supervision and enforcement. It introduces administrative enforcement tools (bestuursdwang, administrative fines) and allows ministerial regulation and general administrative orders to set detailed technical rules.
36797.j: The memorandum justifies the delegation of technical rules to lower-level regulation by the frequency of changes needed to meet international standards.
q: Because these are mostly technical rules that are amended with some regularity, it is desirable to set them at a lower level than the statute.
Omdat het hier veelal technische voorschriften betreft, die met enige regelmaat gewijzigd worden, is het wenselijk om deze regels op een lager niveau dan de wet te kunnen stellen.
d: rules on airspace use and air traffic participants
height, calculation and collection of air traffic service charges
designation of airspace, airports, routes and procedures; airspace design services
manner of providing air navigation services
requirements, validity and procedure for certificates
p: The minister may order corrective measures and suspend or withdraw certificates of service providers when non-compliance is found, with a time-limited corrective plan as a prior step.
The minister is empowered to impose administrative enforcement (bestuursdwang) under the general administrative law procedures.
The minister may impose administrative fines up to the sixth category, subject to bezwaar and beroep under the Wet administratieve rechtspraak BES.
The minister may issue binding directions to air navigation service providers on urgent safety problems, specifying required actions and deadlines.
In special situations the minister may designate parts of airspace where another air traffic service provider than the designated one provides services.

parties: Questions whether the recognition of Curaçao and Sint Maarten certificates with limited supervisory capacity can guarantee high aviation safety, and why supervision is not fully placed with the ILT.
Why was it not chosen to place supervision entirely with the Dutch Human Environment and Transport Inspectorate (ILT)?
Waarom is er niet voor gekozen om het toezicht volledig onder te brengen bij de Nederlandse Inspectie Leefomgeving en Transport (ILT)?
Asks whether supervision at a distance with occasional on-site visits is sufficient and how it compares to current ILT supervision of small airports.
Does this mean there is no permanent on-site supervision, only supervision from a distance (from the Netherlands) with occasional visits on site?
Betekent dit dat er geen permanent toezicht ter plaatse is, maar slechts toezicht op afstand (vanuit Nederland) met af en toe een bezoek ter plaatse?
Asks whether the two-year transitional period and possible suspension or refusal of certificates are covered by contingency plans to protect island connectivity.
What contingency plans does the government have ready to guarantee the continuity of air navigation and thus the accessibility of the islands if a certificate must be suspended or refused?

Welke contingency-plannen heeft de regering klaarliggen om de continuïteit van de luchtvaartnavigatie en daarmee de bereikbaarheid van de eilanden te waarborgen als een certificaat moet worden geschorst of geweigerd?

v.summary: The Raad van State's Afdeling advisering has no remarks on the draft bill amending the Luchtvaartwet BES to implement ICAO requirements for air navigation services and advises submitting it to the Tweede Kamer. The minister's nader rapport reports only minor technical changes (a missing definition added, a conflict clause removed, textual additions to the explanatory memorandum).

36869.s: The bill limits the statutory compensation for transition payments on dismissal due to long-term incapacity for work to small employers only, by amending Article 7:673e of the Dutch Civil Code and adding transitional law. The explanatory memorandum justifies this by the need for sustainable public finances and sets the reference date for the small-employer test at the first UWV or court request.
36869.j: The memorandum justifies the restriction by the need for sustainable public finances and states that limiting compensation to small employers is fair for every employer.
q: it is desirable to limit the transition compensation scheme for dismissal due to long-term incapacity for work to small employers, given the need for sustainable and stable public finances

wenselijk is de compensatieregeling transitievergoeding bij ontslag wegens langdurige arbeidsongeschiktheid te beperken tot kleine werkgevers, gelet op de noodzaak tot houdbare en bestendige overheidsfinanciën
d: number of employees defining small employer for business closure compensation

parties: Asks government to justify retaining the transitievergoeding on dismissal for long-term incapacity and to monitor the rise in dormant employment contracts.
These members ask the government to further substantiate this consideration.
Deze leden vragen de regering om deze afweging nader te onderbouwen.
Asks how the government can justify reintroducing the problems of dormant employment contracts that the compensation was meant to prevent, and whether workers' legal protection is weakened.
Questions whether the restriction goes no further than necessary and asks why the government does not follow the Raad van State's view on discrimination on grounds of disability.
The PVV members ask the government to explain further why it does not follow the Raad van State's view on this point.
De leden van de PVV-fractie vragen de regering nader toe te lichten waarom zij het standpunt van de Raad van State op dit punt niet volgt.
Asks for reflection on the Raad van State's advice to consider scrapping the compensation scheme and on the consultation of social partners.
These members ask for further reflection on this advice and the reasons why it has not been adopted.
Deze leden vragen om een nadere reflectie op dit advies en de motivatie waarom dit niet wordt overgenomen.
Asks why the government pursues restricting compensation rather than the Raad van State's alternative, and whether the differentiation is legally tenable under equality principles.
Can the government explain why, despite this dictum and the fundamental balancing of interests requested by the Raad van State, it sticks to the chosen route.
Kan de regering uiteenzetten waarom zij, ondanks dit dictum en de door de Raad van State gevraagde fundamentele belangenafweging, vasthoudt aan de gekozen route.
Worries about effects on labour-intensive firms just above 25 employees and asks how increased dormant contracts will be prevented.
The BBB members ask how concretely it will be prevented that the restriction of compensation leads to more dormant employment contracts.
De leden van de BBB-fractie vragen hoe concreet wordt voorkomen dat de beperking van compensatie leidt tot meer slapende dienstverbanden.
Asks about the grounds for the measure, its consequences for employers and the labour market, and possible sector exemptions.
The SGP members ask about the reason, background and reasoning behind this measure.
De leden van de SGP-fractie vragen naar de reden, de achtergrond en de gedachtegang achter deze maatregel.
Asks how the measure relates to the Xella norm on good employership and whether an exemption for social work companies should be made.
Does the government recognise that it is undesirable that whether a long-term sick employee can invoke good employership and the Xella norm depends on the size of the employer?
Erkent de regering dat het onwenselijk is dat het afhankelijk wordt van de grootte van de werkgever of een langdurig zieke werknemer een beroep kan doen op goed werkgeverschap en de Xella norm?
Asks whether the Xella ruling protecting employees in dormant contracts can be preserved and what rights employees will have.

Can the government explain which options it has examined to preserve that when an employee in a dormant employment contract decides to leave, the employee automatically has a right to the transitievergoeding?

Kan de regering toelichten welke mogelijkheden zij heeft onderzocht om in stand te houden dat wanneer een werknemers in een slapend dienstverband beslist om uit dienst te reden, deze werknemers automatisch recht heeft op de transitievergoeding?

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised reconsidering the bill restricting the transitievergoeding compensation for dismissal due to long-term incapacity to small employers, suggesting instead abolishing the mandatory transition payment for such dismissals, citing fundamental balancing of interests, sleeping employment contracts, unequal treatment, and conflict sensitivity. The government's nader rapport rejects the advice, arguing the measure is a political budget choice, the two purposes differ, the distinction is justified, and the uptake risk and conflict sensitivity are acknowledged but not addressed by changing the bill.
concerns: The Afdeling argues a fundamental balancing of interests is needed because the restriction shifts costs back to employers in about 80% of cases, and advises considering abolishing the mandatory transition payment instead.
The Afdeling notes the explanatory memorandum's claim of unjustified indirect distinction on grounds of disability or chronic illness, and the government disagrees that the cases are equal.

The Afdeling warns that restricting compensation may revive sleeping employment contracts and litigation, which the compensation scheme was meant to end; the government acknowledges the risk increases but does not change the bill.

The Afdeling flags conflict sensitivity of the small-employer definition based on tax classification from two years earlier; the Belastingdienst assesses impact as limited and the government sees no reason to amend.
