36878.s: The bill integrates vocational education, adult education and early school-leaving prevention rules for Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba into the general Wet educatie en beroepsonderwijs and Wet voortgezet onderwijs 2020, replacing the separate Caribbean statute. It makes new vocational programmes in the islands subject to prior ministerial approval and gives the Minister power to set detailed rules and run experiments.
36878.j: The memorandum justifies the new approval power and differentiated rules by the small, fragmented island education system, the need to protect quality and avoid stranded students, and the constitutional allowance for differing rules for the islands.
q: To maintain the quality of vocational education in the Caribbean Netherlands, prevent fragmentation and guarantee an efficient range of programmes, this bill requires prior ministerial consent for other funded institutions to offer funded vocational programmes in a public body.

Om in Caribisch Nederland de kwaliteit van het beroepsonderwijs in stand te houden, de versnippering van het beroepsonderwijs te voorkomen en een doelmatig aanbod aan beroepsopleidingen te waarborgen, wordt in dit wetsvoorstel geregeld dat voor het aanbieden van bekostigde beroepsopleidingen in een openbaar lichaam door andere bekostigde instellingen dan de SGB als thans enige bekostigde instelling aldaar, vooraf instemming van de Minister moet worden verkregen.

p: New vocational programmes in the islands require ministerial approval, with conditions the Minister may attach, giving the executive a gatekeeping role over institutions and students.
Experiments may depart from several statutes by general administrative order, subject to a time limit, a four-week wait after submission to parliament and an evaluation report.
Tasks of the labour market council and its division with the national cooperation body may be set by general administrative order.

parties: Asks whether implementation dates and funding models are feasible and whether the government has verified readiness of implementing parties.
Asks about labour market alignment of training offers and cooperation between Caribbean and European Dutch institutions.
These members ask the government to explain further how it is ensured that the regional training offer is well aligned with the labour market.
Zij vragen de regering nader toe te lichten hoe wordt gewaarborgd dat het regionale opleidingsaanbod goed aansluit bij de arbeidsmarkt.
Questions the absence of a public regulatory role for the island public bodies in preventing early school leaving and asks about data basis and support for implementation.
Can the government explain further why it does not yet want to work towards a comparable public coordinating role for the public bodies in the Caribbean Netherlands?
Kan de regering nader toelichten waarom zij in dezen vooralsnog nog niet wil werken naar een vergelijkbare publieke regierol voor de openbare lichamen in Caribisch Nederland?
Asks for precise definitions and measurable indicators of the 'equivalent facility level' and warns that regulatory stacking may exceed implementation capacity on the islands.
These members ask the government how it is prevented that abandoning legislative restraint leads to a stacking of regulations that exceeds implementation capacity on the islands.
Deze leden vragen de regering hoe wordt voorkomen dat het loslaten van legislatieve terughoudendheid leidt tot een stapeling van regelgeving die de uitvoeringskracht op de eilanden overstijgt.

Notes the bill contains many delegation provisions that make practical effects hard to foresee and questions whether the extra admission check for institutions constitutes a restriction on freedom of education.
However, this bill contains many delegation provisions. These members therefore find it difficult to foresee how the law will work out in practice on the islands.
Dit wetsvoorstel bevat echter veel delegatiebepalingen. Daarom vinden deze leden het lastig te overzien hoe de wet in praktijk op de eilanden zal uitwerken.
Questions consequences of dropping Dutch language from pass/fail rules for language proficiency and for students moving to the Netherlands.
The JA21 members ask the government what consequences this change has, in its view, for command of the Kingdom language in the Caribbean Netherlands.
De leden van de JA21-fractie vragen de regering welke gevolgen deze wijziging volgens de regering heeft voor de beheersing van de Koninkrijkstaal in Caribisch Nederland?
Has no questions for the government.
These members have no questions for the government.
Deze leden hebben geen vragen aan de regering.

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division advised on the bill modernising vocational and adult education rules and early school-leaving prevention in Caribbean Netherlands, raising broad delegation grounds, the lack of ministerial oversight of the ROA, subsidy law gaps, data transfer adequacy, financial effects, and evaluation design. The minister's reply largely accepts the advice, amending delegation grounds, applying Kaderwet provisions and Awb title 4.2, adding safeguards and financial clarification, and specifying evaluation aspects.
concerns: Broad delegation grounds allowing lower regulation to set structural elements without concrete limits were not justified and were narrowed.
Insufficient ministerial responsibility and democratic control over the ROA because the Kaderwet zelfstandige bestuursorganen does not apply; partial application adopted.
Unclear which general subsidy rules apply to the ROA subsidy; Awb title 4.2 is now applied by analogy.

The Wbp BES may not provide an adequate level of protection for transfers under the AVG; additional measures such as self-evaluations and training were added, though a consensus law is not yet in force.

Processing of religion, belief and health data in absence reports needs justification and safeguards under the Wbp BES; the explanatory memorandum was clarified, while stating the rules are not new policy.
Financial consequences for adult education and school housing were unclear and needed to be stated, with sufficient funds if necessary; the memorandum was supplemented.
Evaluation criteria, method and aspects were not specified; the memorandum now lists relevant evaluation aspects.

36915-III.s: This first supplementary budget bill amends the 2026 budget statements for the Ministry of General Affairs, the Cabinet of the King, and the Oversight Committee on the Intelligence and Security Services (CTIVD), with amounts in thousands of euros and retroactive effect to 1 June 2026. It adjusts spending for wage and price increases, the creation of a Bureau Bestuursraad Rijk, carried-over year-end margins, and extra CTIVD housing costs.
q: Thus it is that We, in common consultation with the States General, have found fit and resolved, as We hereby find fit and resolve
Zo is het, dat Wij, met gemeen overleg der Staten-Generaal, hebben goedgevonden en verstaan, gelijk Wij goedvinden en verstaan bij deze
